'''Tavalad''' will be the clan chief of the [[Goshien]] Aiel, seventeen years after the [[Last Battle]]. 

He is seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]]. He attends the meeting where the Aiel decide to go to war with the [[Seanchan]] and [[Padra]] thinks he and [[Darvin]] are the only ones not convinced by the decision.
